$comment: Packaging contract for the Windows Standalone ZIP, consumed by scripts/build_standalone.ps1.
Every entry is a path RELATIVE to the repository root unless stated otherwise.
Directories are copied recursively from git-tracked files (so new files inside them
ship automatically). Files are copied verbatim. Adding a root-level file to the
project means adding it to upstream.files below - the build fails if a path is
missing, which is how targets.json going absent was caught.

$required_comment: targets.json is resolved by backend/targets/__init__.py at the checkout root
and is also a modern-checkout marker, so a package without it will not start.

$link_rewrites_comment: The repository README and docs link to each other across the repo/standalone
boundary. Inside the ZIP that boundary moves, so these literal replacements keep
